notes:
What's new in v1.12.0

New
- Repeat blocks, a Run macro step and playback speed: build loops, call other macros, and speed runs up or down
- Timer triggers: fire a macro on an interval or at a set time
- Undo and redo while editing macros
- App themes: Default, Midnight, OLED and Slate, with 8 accent colours
- Cloud backup: save your macros to your account and restore them on any PC
- A Home page: click the Reflex logo for your stats and quick actions
- A Keyboard page: see your binds on a visual keyboard
- Bigger in-game HUD: Keystrokes & CPS, Clock, PC stats, active remaps and macro progress, each with its own look and a show/hide hotkey
- A first-time walkthrough tour
- Upgrade from monthly to lifetime for $6.99 — your existing key simply becomes lifetime, with no more monthly bills

Fixes
- Mouse and keyboard input is more human: natural timing and a subtle mouse-glide wobble
- CPS counts only the clicks that reach your game, so a one-click macro reads as one
- Steps and Script stay in sync, and step notes are kept when you switch between them
- Turning a macro off now stops it instantly if it's running
- Repeat counts are exact, and deleting one repeat marker removes its pair
- Security and stability hardening
